fields.headline: Accepts a $125,000 first-year grant to host a regional workforce pathways coordinator
fields.summary: The board is accepting a Year 1 grant of $125,000 and approving a sub-agreement with the Rancho Santiago Community College District to host and supervise a K12 Workforce Pathways Coordinator. The coordinator will serve the region covering the Peralta Community College District and its six feeder school districts, including Oakland Unified. The grant term is March 1 through December 31, 2020. The official text misprints the amount as "$125,00.00"; the attached grant documents show $125,000.00.
